learning_outcomes.text: Design and analyze single-phase and three-phase electrical circuits, direct current and alternating current, ensuring their operation and safety.
Understand the principles governing the operation of electrical machines.
Apply electromagnetism principles to electrical machines.
Is capable of designing, simulating, and building electrical circuits in the laboratory, obtaining results, and drawing conclusions from these.
Is capable of working in a team, applying critical reasoning, making decisions, and communicating knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

teaching_methods: Classroom presentation of concepts related to the subjects that make up each topic and problem-solving to enable students to know how to approach them, as well as other face-to-face group sessions such as discussion classes, sharing, etc.
Laboratory activities of increasing difficulty that allow students to acquire the ability to achieve autonomy in problem-solving.
Completion of work in small groups.
Personal study, report writing, practical work, etc., as independent work by the student or group of students.

assessment_methods.method: Deliverables: Knowledge and principles of electromagnetism applied to electrical machines

assessment_rules: To pass the course, it is necessary to have passed the practical work and completed the required assignments (through continuous assessment, ordinary and extraordinary calls). In the ordinary and extraordinary calls, the grade will be established as follows: 75% (exam) + 25% (lab grade and assignments).
